METALLURGICAL RIGOUR & POLYMER SCIENCE

Engineering & Safety Specifications

Compare the metallurgical and material engineering behind our SS316 molybdenum marine steel invisible grills vs. UV-stabilized virgin Garware HDPE safety nets.

METALLURGY 01

SS316 Marine-Grade Steel

Core Alloy Composition: Virgin AISI 316 (16-18% Cr, 10-14% Ni, 2-3% Molybdenum)
Tensile Breaking Strength: 400+ kgf breaking load per individual cable strand
Cable Core Architecture: 7×7 multi-strand core (49 micro-wires wound in counter-tension)
Protective Sheathing: DuPont Pure Nylon-12 transparent casing (UV & scratch immune)
Track Mounting Profile: 6063-T6 architectural powder-coated aluminium structural profile
Corrosion Resistance: 100% rust-proof against coastal sea breeze & hard water washes
Direct Warranty Coverage: 15-Year Direct Written Guarantee against rust & structural sag
POLYMER 02

Garware UV-Stabilized HDPE

Polymer Grade: 100% Virgin High-Density Polyethylene (Garware Technical Fibres)
Tensile Energy Absorption: High elastic shock-absorption (cushions accidental toddler falls)
Filament Construction: 0.7mm to 1.2mm multi-strand braided monofilament & co-polymer
UV Stabilization Tech: Carbon black & hindered amine UV light stabilizers (anti-brittleness)
Pigeon Exclusion Factor: 100% humane barrier without bird entanglement or feather entrapment
Wind Resistance & Drag: 99% aerodynamic wind passage (zero whistling or fluttering)
Direct Warranty Coverage: 5-Year Weatherproof Guarantee against rotting & UV degradation
Engineering Specification SS316 Invisible Grills Garware HDPE Safety Nets Traditional MS Box Grills
Tensile Breaking Strength 400+ kgf per cable 180+ kgf impact absorption Rigid welded joints (brittle welds)
Daylight & View Preservation 98% Transparent (Skyline vista) 85–90% Translucent mesh Blocks 40–60% natural light
Coastal Salt & Rust Resistance 100% Rust-Proof (Molybdenum AISI 316) Inert to salt (Zero rot or corrosion) Severe rusting in 18–24 months
Society Elevation Compliance 100% Approved across all RWAs Approved for balconies & shafts Frequently banned by RWA bylaws
Emergency Fire Evacuation Cut in 10s with wire cutters Cut in 5s with emergency shears Traps residents (requires oxy-torch)
Recommended Balcony Application Living room balconies & French windows Utility balconies, ducts & AC ledges Ground floor security grills only
